verdict.rationale: Mixpanel publishes a well-documented public API surface (Query API, Raw Event Export API, Engage API, JQL for custom queries, Feature Flags API) that lets any client—including an AI agent—programmatically read and act on data, and it additionally ships a hosted MCP server letting AI assistants query events, funnels, retention, and replays via natural language. This goes beyond typical 'documented API' stories by explicitly targeting AI-native access patterns. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger endpoints all returned 404 in probes) and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's reliability.
